key_concepts: Light travels in a straight line
Reflection is light bouncing back toward its source
Mirrors and shiny surfaces reflect light
Refraction is the bending of light between different media
Objects partly in water can appear bent or broken due to refraction
White light is made up of different colors
Dispersion separates visible light into its colors
The rainbow colors are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet
Rainbows form when sunlight passes through raindrops
Mirror images of printed text appear reversed or inverted
